tool_args.rationale: The pilot signatures support a gradient-dependent sink and coupled memory dynamics. The fine trajectory batch adds observations that can distinguish the fast relaxation timescale from coupling strength before fitting the five-parameter ODE.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit the five-parameter siphon-memory ODE now
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Five endpoint measurements at similar horizons leave no residual degrees of freedom and weakly separate memory relaxation from coupling strength.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit a static Haldane or Cobb–Douglas law
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Neither model accounts for the observed transient lag or uses the initial state and memory.
It does not resolve the ambiguity between memory relaxation and coupling strength.
